'''Ethan Roberts Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Ethan Roberts]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19804">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19804 Maelstrom the Merchant Deck], DeckTech (Ethan "MeeWee" Roberts, 22 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19804/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19804/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016225707/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19804/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ethan Roberts]]
* '''Published:''' 22 November 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 LU Roberts LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Tatooine: Jundland Wastes (Official Tournament Sealed Deck), Ardon 'Vapor' Crell, Descent Into The Dark: no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' This deck cycles through your entire reserve deck in two turns allowing you to set up massive battles, drains and regeneration before the opponent can react.
